It may be noted th

at such recovery of liquidated damages may be up to a ceiling of 10% of the contract/PO price of the whole unit of stores which the contractor /supplier has failed to deliver within the period fixed for delivery; or (b) Cancel the contract/PO or a portion thereof by serving prior notice t o the contractor/ supplier.
